AbortBucketWorm.description_en: Deletes an unlocked retention policy from a specified bucket
AbortBucketWorm.description_zh: 删除指定存储空间（Bucket）未锁定的合规保留策略

AbortMultipartUpload.description_en: Cancels a multipart upload event and deletes the corresponding part data
AbortMultipartUpload.description_zh: 用于取消MultipartUpload事件并删除对应的Part数据

AppendObject.description_en: Uploads an object by using append upload
AppendObject.description_zh: 以追加写的方式上传文件（Object）

CloseMetaQuery.description_en: Disables the metadata management feature for a bucket. OSS automatically deletes the metadata index of the bucket, and metadata indexing becomes unavailable
CloseMetaQuery.description_zh: 关闭存储空间（Bucket）的元数据管理功能。OSS会自动删除Bucket的元数据索引库，将无法进行元数据索引

CompleteBucketWorm.description_en: Invokes the CompleteBucketWorm operation to lock a data retention policy
CompleteBucketWorm.description_zh: 调用CompleteBucketWorm接口锁定合规保留策略

CompleteMultipartUpload.description_en: Completes the multipart upload of an entire file
CompleteMultipartUpload.description_zh: 来完成整个文件的分片上传

CopyObject.description_en: Copies an object within the same region between the same or different buckets
CopyObject.description_zh: 拷贝同一地域下相同或不同存储空间（Bucket）之间的文件（Object）

CreateBucketDataRedundancyTransition.description_en: Creates a data redundancy type conversion task for a bucket
CreateBucketDataRedundancyTransition.description_zh: 为Bucket创建存储冗余转换任务

CreateCnameToken.description_en: Creates a CnameToken required for domain name ownership verification
CreateCnameToken.description_zh: 创建域名所有权验证所需的CnameToken

CreateSelectObjectMeta.description_en: Retrieves the total number of rows, total number of columns (for CSV files), and the number of splits for a target file. If this information does not exist, the entire file is scanned, analyzed, and the information is recorded. Subsequent calls to this API return the saved information without rescanning the entire file
CreateSelectObjectMeta.description_zh: 获取目标文件总的行数，总的列数（对于CSV文件），以及Splits个数。如果该信息不存在，则会扫描整个文件，分析并记录下CSV文件的上述信息。重复调用该API则会保存上述信息而不必重新扫描整个文件

DeleteBucketCommonHeader.description_en: Deletes the custom HTTP header configuration of a bucket
DeleteBucketCommonHeader.description_zh: 删除存储空间的用户自定义响应头配置

DeleteBucketCors.description_en: Calls the DeleteBucketCors operation to disable the Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) feature for a specified bucket and clear all rules
DeleteBucketCors.description_zh: 调用DeleteBucketCors接口关闭指定存储空间（Bucket）的跨域资源共享CORS（Cross-Origin Resource Sharing）功能并清空所有规则

DeleteBucketEncryption.description_en: Deletes the encryption rule of a specified bucket
DeleteBucketEncryption.description_zh: 删除指定存储空间（Bucket）的加密规则

DeleteBucketInventory.description_en: Deletes a specified inventory rule from a bucket
DeleteBucketInventory.description_zh: 删除某个存储空间（Bucket）中指定的清单（Inventory）任务

DeleteBucketLifecycle.description_en: Deletes the lifecycle rules of a specified bucket
DeleteBucketLifecycle.description_zh: 调用DeleteBucketLifecycle接口删除指定存储空间（Bucket）的生命周期规则

DeleteBucketLogging.description_en: Shuts down the access logging feature for a bucket
DeleteBucketLogging.description_zh: 关闭存储空间（Bucket）的访问日志记录功能

DeleteBucketPolicy.description_en: Deletes the access policy of a specified bucket
DeleteBucketPolicy.description_zh: 删除指定存储空间（Bucket）的权限策略（Policy）

DeleteBucketReplication.description_en: Stops data replication for a bucket and deletes the replication configuration of the bucket. After this operation, any operations on the source bucket are no longer synchronized to the destination bucket
DeleteBucketReplication.description_zh: 停止某个存储空间（Bucket）的数据复制并删除Bucket的复制配置，此时源Bucket中的任何操作都不会被同步到目标Bucket

DeleteBucketWebsite.description_en: Disables the static website hosting mode and redirection rules for a bucket
DeleteBucketWebsite.description_zh: 关闭存储空间（Bucket）的静态网站托管模式以及跳转规则

DeleteCname.description_en: Deletes a CNAME that is binded to a bucket
DeleteCname.description_zh: 删除某个存储空间（Bucket）已绑定的Cname

DeleteObjectTagging.description_en: Deletes the tagging information of a specified object
DeleteObjectTagging.description_zh: 删除指定对象（Object）的标签（Tagging）信息

DeletePublicAccessBlock.description_en: Deletes the user-level Block Public Access configuration
DeletePublicAccessBlock.description_zh: 删除用户级别的阻止公共访问配置

DeleteStyle.description_en: Deletes a specified image style from a bucket
DeleteStyle.description_zh: 删除某个Bucket下指定的图片样式

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the endpoint information of all supported regions or a specified region, including the public endpoint, internal network endpoint, and transfer acceleration endpoint
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询所有支持地域或者指定地域对应的Endpoint信息，包括外网Endpoint、内网Endpoint和传输加速Endpoint

DoMetaQuery.description_en: Queries objects that meet specified conditions by using the metadata indexing feature of a bucket, and lists object information sorted by the specified field and sort order
DoMetaQuery.description_zh: 通过存储空间（Bucket）的元数据索引功能，查询满足指定条件的文件（Object），并按照字段和排序方式列出文件信息

ExtendBucketWorm.description_en: Extends the retention period for objects in a bucket that has a locked data retention policy
ExtendBucketWorm.description_zh: 延长已锁定的合规保留策略对应Bucket中Object的保留天数

GetAccessPoint.description_en: Retrieves the information about an access point

GetAccessPointPolicy.description_en: Retrieves the access point policy configuration

GetBucketAccessMonitor.description_en: Queries whether the access tracking feature is enabled for a bucket
GetBucketAccessMonitor.description_zh: 获取存储空间（Bucket）的访问追踪功能是否开启

GetBucketAcl.description_en: Retrieves the access permissions of a bucket. Only the bucket owner can retrieve the access permissions of the bucket
GetBucketAcl.description_zh: 获取某个存储空间（Bucket）的访问权限（ACL）。只有Bucket的拥有者才能获取Bucket的访问权限

GetBucketCors.description_en: Retrieves the current cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) rules of a specified bucket
GetBucketCors.description_zh: 获取指定存储空间（Bucket）当前的跨域资源共享CORS（Cross-Origin Resource Sharing）规则

GetBucketEncryption.description_en: Retrieves the encryption rule of a bucket
GetBucketEncryption.description_zh: 获取存储空间（Bucket）的加密规则

GetBucketEventNotification.description_en: Retrieves the event notification configuration of a bucket
GetBucketEventNotification.description_zh: 获取存储空间事件通知配置

GetBucketHttpsConfig.description_en: Queries the TLS version settings of a bucket by calling the GetBucketHttpsConfig operation
GetBucketHttpsConfig.description_zh: 调用GetBucketHttpsConfig接口查看Bucket的TLS版本设置

GetBucketInfo.description_en: Queries information about a bucket. Only the bucket owner can query the bucket information. This request can be initiated from any Object Storage Service (OSS) endpoint
GetBucketInfo.description_zh: 查看存储空间（Bucket）的相关信息。只有Bucket的拥有者才能查看Bucket的信息。该请求可以从任何一个OSS的Endpoint发起

GetBucketInventory.description_en: Queries a specified inventory rule for a bucket
GetBucketInventory.description_zh: 查看某个存储空间（Bucket）中指定的清单（Inventory）任务

GetBucketLifecycle.description_en: Queries the lifecycle rules of a bucket. Only the bucket owner has the permission to query the lifecycle rules of a bucket
GetBucketLifecycle.description_zh: 查看存储空间（Bucket）的生命周期规则（Lifecycle）。只有Bucket的拥有者才有权限查看Bucket的生命周期规则

GetBucketLocation.description_en: Queries the location information of a bucket. Only the bucket owner can query the location information of the bucket
GetBucketLocation.description_zh: 查看存储空间（Bucket）的位置信息。只有Bucket的拥有者才能查看Bucket的位置信息

GetBucketLogging.description_en: Queries the access logging configuration of a bucket. Only the bucket owner can query the access logging configuration of a bucket
GetBucketLogging.description_zh: 查看存储空间（Bucket）的访问日志配置。只有Bucket的拥有者才能查看Bucket的访问日志配置

GetBucketObjectWormConfiguration.description_en: Retrieves the object-level data retention policy configured on a bucket
GetBucketObjectWormConfiguration.description_zh: 在Bucket上获取对象级别保留策略

GetBucketPolicy.description_en: Retrieves the access policy of a specified bucket
GetBucketPolicy.description_zh: 获取指定存储空间（Bucket）的权限策略（Policy）

GetBucketReferer.description_en: Queries the hotlink protection (Referer) configurations of a bucket
GetBucketReferer.description_zh: 查看存储空间（Bucket）的防盗链（Referer）相关配置

GetBucketReplication.description_en: Retrieves the data replication rules configured for a bucket
GetBucketReplication.description_zh: 获取某个存储空间（Bucket）已设置的数据复制规则

GetBucketReplicationLocation.description_en: Retrieves the regions to which a source bucket can be replicated. You can use the response to determine the destination region for data replication from the source bucket
GetBucketReplicationLocation.description_zh: 获取可复制到的目标存储空间（Bucket）所在的地域。您可以根据返回结果决定将源Bucket的数据复制到哪个地域

GetBucketReplicationProgress.description_en: Retrieves the data replication progress of a bucket
GetBucketReplicationProgress.description_zh: 获取某个存储空间（Bucket）的数据复制进度

GetBucketRequestPayment.description_en: Retrieves the pay-by-requester configuration of a bucket
GetBucketRequestPayment.description_zh: 获取请求者付费模式的配置信息

GetBucketResourceGroup.description_en: Retrieves the resource group ID of a bucket
GetBucketResourceGroup.description_zh: 获取存储空间（Bucket）所属的资源组ID

GetBucketStat.description_en: Retrieves the storage capacity and object count of a specified bucket
GetBucketStat.description_zh: 获取指定存储空间的存储容量以及文件数量

GetBucketTags.description_en: Retrieves the tagging information of a bucket
GetBucketTags.description_zh: 获取存储空间（Bucket）的标签信息

GetBucketTransferAcceleration.description_en: Calls the GetBucketTransferAcceleration operation to obtain the transfer acceleration configuration of a bucket
GetBucketTransferAcceleration.description_zh: 调用GetBucketTransferAcceleration接口获取目标存储空间（Bucket）的传输加速配置

GetBucketVersioning.description_en: Calls the GetBucketVersioning operation to retrieve the versioning status of a specified bucket
GetBucketVersioning.description_zh: 调用GetBucketVersioning接口获取指定Bucket的版本控制状态

GetBucketWebsite.description_en: Queries the static website hosting status and redirection rules of a bucket
GetBucketWebsite.description_zh: 查看存储空间（Bucket）的静态网站托管状态以及跳转规则

GetBucketWorm.description_en: Retrieves the data retention policy information of a specified bucket
GetBucketWorm.description_zh: 获取指定存储空间（Bucket）的合规保留策略信息

GetLiveChannelHistory.description_en: Retrieves the streaming records of a specified LiveChannel

GetLiveChannelInfo.description_en: Retrieves the configuration information of a specified LiveChannel

GetLiveChannelStat.description_en: Retrieves the streaming status of a specified LiveChannel
GetLiveChannelStat.description_zh: 获取指定LiveChannel的推流状态信息

GetMetaQueryStatus.description_en: Retrieves the metadata index information of a specified bucket
GetMetaQueryStatus.description_zh: 获取指定存储空间（Bucket）的元数据索引库信息

GetObjectAcl.description_en: Retrieves the access permissions of a file (Object) in a bucket
GetObjectAcl.description_zh: 获取存储空间（Bucket）下某个文件（Object）的访问权限（ACL）

GetObjectLegalHold.description_en: Retrieves the legal hold status of an object
GetObjectLegalHold.description_zh: 在Object上获取对象合法保留

GetObjectMeta.description_en: Retrieves the metadata of an object, including the ETag, Size, and LastModified information, without returning the object content
GetObjectMeta.description_zh: 获取文件（Object）的元数据信息，包括该Object的ETag、Size、LastModified信息，并且不返回该Object的内容

GetObjectRetention.description_en: Configures an object-level data retention policy on an object
GetObjectRetention.description_zh: 在Object上配置对象级别保留策略

GetObjectTagging.description_en: Retrieves the tagging information of an object

GetPublicAccessBlock.description_en: Retrieves the Block Public Access configuration bound at the user level
GetPublicAccessBlock.description_zh: 获取绑定在用户级别的阻止公共访问的配置

GetStyle.description_en: Queries the information about a specified image style in a bucket
GetStyle.description_zh: 查询某个Bucket下指定的图片样式信息

GetSymlink.description_en: Retrieves the symbolic link of a specified target object (TargetObject) in OSS
GetSymlink.description_zh: 获取OSS目标文件（TargetObject）的软链接

GetUserAntiDDosInfo.description_en: Queries the information about OSS DDoS protection instances under a specified account
GetUserAntiDDosInfo.description_zh: 查询指定账号下的高防OSS实例信息

GetVodPlaylist.description_en: Queries the playlist generated by stream pushing for a specified LiveChannel within a specified time range
GetVodPlaylist.description_zh: 查看指定LiveChannel在指定时间段内推流生成的播放列表

HeadObject.description_en: Retrieves the metadata of an object
HeadObject.description_zh: 获取某个文件（Object）的元信息

InitUserAntiDDosInfo.description_en: Creates an OSS DDoS protection instance

InitiateBucketWorm.description_zh: 新建一条合规保留策略

InitiateMultipartUpload.description_en: Notifies OSS to initialize a multipart upload event
InitiateMultipartUpload.description_zh: 通知OSS初始化一个Multipart Upload事件

ListAccessPoints.description_en: Retrieves access point information at the user level or bucket level
ListAccessPoints.description_zh: 获取用户级别或Bucket级别的接入点信息

ListAccessPointsForObjectProcess.description_en: Retrieves user-level Object FC Access Point information
ListAccessPointsForObjectProcess.description_zh: 获取用户级别的对象FC接入点信息

ListBucketAntiDDosInfo.description_en: Retrieves the list of bucket protection information

ListBucketDataRedundancyTransition.description_en: Lists all data redundancy type conversion tasks for a bucket
ListBucketDataRedundancyTransition.description_zh: 列举某个Bucket下所有的存储冗余转换任务

ListBucketInventory.description_en: Retrieves all inventory rules configured for a bucket
ListBucketInventory.description_zh: 批量获取某个存储空间（Bucket）中的所有清单（Inventory）任务

ListBuckets.description_en: Lists all buckets owned by the requester
ListBuckets.description_zh: 列举请求者拥有的所有存储空间（Bucket）

ListCname.description_en: Queries the list of all custom domain names (CNAMEs) bound to a bucket
ListCname.description_zh: 查询某个存储空间（Bucket）下绑定的所有的自定义域名（Cname）列表

ListDataLakeStorageTransferJob.description_en: List data lake metadata transformation jobs

ListMultipartUploads.description_en: Lists all in-progress multipart upload events
ListMultipartUploads.description_zh: 列举所有执行中的Multipart Upload事件

ListObjectVersions.description_en: Lists the version information of all objects in a bucket, including delete markers
ListObjectVersions.description_zh: 列出Bucket中包括删除标记（Delete Marker）在内的所有Object的版本信息

ListObjects.description_en: Lists information about all objects in a bucket
ListObjects.description_zh: 列举存储空间（Bucket）中所有文件（Object）的信息

ListObjectsV2.description_en: Lists information about all objects in a bucket
ListObjectsV2.description_zh: 列举存储空间（Bucket）中所有文件（Object）的信息

ListParts.description_en: Lists all parts that have been successfully uploaded for a specified upload ID
ListParts.description_zh: 列举指定Upload ID所属的所有已经上传成功Part

ListStyle.description_en: Queries all image styles that have been created for a specified bucket
ListStyle.description_zh: 查询某个Bucket下已创建的所有图片样式

OpenMetaQuery.description_en: Enables the metadata management feature. After the metadata management feature is enabled, Object Storage Service (OSS) creates a metadata index library for the bucket and builds metadata indexes for all objects in the bucket. After the metadata index library is created, OSS continues to perform near-real-time incremental tracking scans on new objects in the bucket and builds metadata indexes for the incremental objects
OpenMetaQuery.description_zh: 开启元数据管理功能。开启元数据管理功能后，OSS会为Bucket创建元数据索引库并为Bucket中的所有文件（Object）建立元数据索引。元数据索引库创建完成后，OSS会继续对Bucket中新增文件进行准实时的增量追踪扫描并为增量文件建立元数据索引

OptionObject.description_en: Before sending a cross-origin request, a browser sends a preflight request (OPTIONS) to OSS with specific information such as the origin domain, HTTP method, and headers to determine whether to send the actual request
OptionObject.description_zh: 浏览器在发送跨域请求之前会发送一个preflight请求（Options）给OSS，并带上特定的来源域、HTTP方法和header等信息，以决定是否发送真正的请求

PostObject.description_en: Upload a file (Object) to a specified bucket by using an HTML form
PostObject.description_zh: 通过HTML表单上传的方式将文件（Object）上传到指定存储空间（Bucket）

PostVodPlaylist.description_en: Generates a Video on Demand (VOD) playlist for a specified LiveChannel
PostVodPlaylist.description_zh: 为指定的LiveChannel生成一个点播用的播放列表

PutAccessPointPublicAccessBlock.description_en: Modifies the Block Public Access configuration of a specified access point
PutAccessPointPublicAccessBlock.description_zh: 修改指定接入点的阻止公共访问的配置信息

PutBucketAccessMonitor.description_en: Modifies the access tracking status of a bucket
PutBucketAccessMonitor.description_zh: 修改存储空间（Bucket）的访问追踪状态

PutBucketAcl.description_en: Sets or modifies the access permissions (ACL) of a bucket
PutBucketAcl.description_zh: 设置或修改存储空间（Bucket）的访问权限（ACL）

PutBucketCommonHeader.description_en: Sets the custom HTTP response header configuration for a bucket
PutBucketCommonHeader.description_zh: 设置存储空间的用户自定义响应头配置

PutBucketCors.description_en: Configures cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) rules for a specified bucket
PutBucketCors.description_zh: 设置指定存储空间（Bucket）的跨域资源共享CORS（Cross-Origin Resource Sharing）规则

PutBucketEncryption.description_en: Configures the encryption rule for a bucket
PutBucketEncryption.description_zh: 配置存储空间（Bucket）的加密规则

PutBucketHash.description_en: Modifies the hash algorithm configuration of a bucket
PutBucketHash.description_zh: 修改存储空间哈希算法配置

PutBucketHttpsConfig.description_en: Calls the PutBucketHttpsConfig operation to enable or disable TLS version settings for a bucket
PutBucketHttpsConfig.description_zh: 调用PutBucketHttpsConfig接口为Bucket开启或关闭TLS版本设置

PutBucketInventory.description_en: Configures an inventory rule for a specified bucket
PutBucketInventory.description_zh: 为指定存储空间（Bucket）配置清单（Inventory）规则

PutBucketLifecycle.description_en: Configures lifecycle rules for a bucket
PutBucketLifecycle.description_zh: 设置存储空间的生命周期规则

PutBucketLogging.description_en: Enables the logging feature for a bucket. Access logs are generated on an hourly basis as log files and written to a specified bucket based on a fixed naming convention
PutBucketLogging.description_zh: 为存储空间（Bucket）开启日志转存功能，可将OSS的访问日志按照固定命名规则，以小时为单位生成日志文件写入您指定的Bucket

PutBucketObjectWormConfiguration.description_en: Enables object retention on a bucket and configures the default data retention policy
PutBucketObjectWormConfiguration.description_zh: 在Bucket上启用对象保留并配置默认保留策略

PutBucketPolicy.description_en: Sets an access policy for a specified bucket
PutBucketPolicy.description_zh: 为指定的存储空间（Bucket）设置授权策略（Policy)

PutBucketReferer.description_en: Configures the hotlink protection (Referer) whitelist at the bucket level. You can specify whether to allow requests with an empty Referer field and whether to allow requests with a truncated query string to access OSS
PutBucketReferer.description_zh: 设置存储空间（Bucket）级别的防盗链（Referer）访问白名单，支持设置是否允许Referer字段为空以及是否允许截断QueryString的请求访问OSS

PutBucketReplication.description_en: Specifies a data replication rule for a bucket. Object Storage Service (OSS) supports Cross-Region Replication (CRR) and Same-Region Replication (SRR)
PutBucketReplication.description_zh: 为存储空间（Bucket）指定数据复制规则。OSS支持跨区域复制（Cross-Region Replication）和同区域复制（Same-Region Replication）

PutBucketRequestPayment.description_en: Sets the pay-by-requester settings for a bucket
PutBucketRequestPayment.description_zh: 设置某个存储空间（Bucket）的请求者付费模式

PutBucketResourceGroup.description_en: Modifies the resource group ID of a bucket
PutBucketResourceGroup.description_zh: 修改存储空间（Bucket）所属的资源组ID

PutBucketRtc.description_en: Enables or shuts down the replication time control (RTC) feature for an existing cross-region replication rule
PutBucketRtc.description_zh: 为已有的跨区域复制规则开启或关闭数据复制时间控制（RTC）功能

PutBucketTags.description_en: Adds or modifies tags for a bucket
PutBucketTags.description_zh: 给某个存储空间（Bucket）添加或修改标签

PutBucketTransferAcceleration.description_en: Calls the PutBucketTransferAcceleration operation to configure transfer acceleration for a bucket. After transfer acceleration is enabled, users around the world can access Object Storage Service (OSS) at higher speeds. This feature is applicable to scenarios such as remote data transfer and upload or download of large files at the GB or TB level
PutBucketTransferAcceleration.description_zh: 调用PutBucketTransferAcceleration接口为存储空间（Bucket）配置传输加速。开启传输加速后，可提升全球各地用户对OSS的访问速度，适用于远距离数据传输、GB或TB级大文件上传和下载的场景

PutBucketVersioning.description_en: Sets the versioning state of a specified bucket
PutBucketVersioning.description_zh: 设置指定存储空间（Bucket）的版本控制状态

PutBucketWebsite.description_en: Sets a bucket to static website hosting mode and configures redirection rules (RoutingRule)
PutBucketWebsite.description_zh: 将存储空间（Bucket）设置为静态网站托管模式并设置跳转规则（RoutingRule）

PutCname.description_en: Binds a custom domain name to a bucket
PutCname.description_zh: 为某个存储空间（Bucket）绑定自定义域名

PutDataLakeCachePrefetchJob.description_en: Configure OSS accelerator asynchronous prefetch rules

PutLiveChannel.description_en: Creates a LiveChannel. You must create a LiveChannel before uploading audio and video data by using the RTMP protocol
PutLiveChannel.description_zh: 通过RTMP协议上传音视频数据前，必须先创建一个LiveChannel

PutLiveChannelStatus.description_en: Switches a LiveChannel between the enabled and disabled states
PutLiveChannelStatus.description_zh: 切换LiveChannel启用（enabled）和禁用（disabled）两种状态

PutObjectAcl.description_en: Modifies the access permissions (ACL) of a file (object)

PutObjectLegalHold.description_en: Configures the legal hold on an object
PutObjectLegalHold.description_zh: 在Object上配置对象合法持有

PutObjectRetention.description_en: Configures an object-level data retention policy on an object
PutObjectRetention.description_zh: 在Object上配置对象级别保留策略

PutObjectTagging.description_en: Sets or updates the tagging information of an object
PutObjectTagging.description_zh: 设置或更新对象（Object）的标签（Tagging）信息

PutProcessConfiguration.description_en: Modifies the media processing configuration of a bucket
PutProcessConfiguration.description_zh: 修改存储空间媒体处理配置

PutPublicAccessBlock.description_en: Modifies the Block Public Access configuration at the OSS global level
PutPublicAccessBlock.description_zh: 修改OSS全局阻止公共访问的配置信息

PutStyle.description_en: Creates an image style. An image style can contain one or more image processing parameters
PutStyle.description_zh: 新增图片样式。一个图片样式中可以包含单个或多个图片处理参数

PutSymlink.description_en: Creates a symbolic link (Symlink) for a target object (TargetObject) in OSS
PutSymlink.description_zh: 为OSS的目标文件（TargetObject）创建软链接（Symlink）

RestoreObject.description_en: Restores an Archive or Cold Archive object
RestoreObject.description_zh: 解冻归档类型（Archive）或冷归档（Cold Archive）的文件（Object）

SealAppendObject.description_en: Seals an appendable object created by the AppendObject operation to prevent further writes. After this operation is performed, you can configure a lifecycle rule to convert the storage class of the appendable object to Cold Archive or Deep Cold Archive
SealAppendObject.description_zh: 通过AppendObject操作创建的Appendable Object，SealAppendable 操作用于Appendable Object停止继续写入。执行该操作后，允许用户通过配置生命周期来将对应的Appendable Object存储类型转为冷归档或深度冷归档存储类型

SelectObject.description_en: Executes an SQL statement on a specified object and returns the execution result
SelectObject.description_zh: 对目标文件执行SQL语句，返回执行结果

StartDataLakeCachePrefetchJob.description_en: Start an asynchronous prefetch job for the OSS accelerator

UpdateBucketAntiDDosInfo.description_en: Updates the protection status of a bucket

UpdateUserAntiDDosInfo.description_en: Changes the instance status of an OSS DDoS protection instance

UploadPart.description_en: Uploads data in parts based on the specified object name and upload ID
UploadPart.description_zh: 根据指定的Object名和uploadId来分块（Part）上传数据

UploadPartCopy.description_en: Copies data from an existing object to upload a part
UploadPartCopy.description_zh: 从一个已存在的Object中拷贝数据来上传一个Part
